How to test split screen: (1) Enable the Car Launcher split-screen accessibility service in the settings page that opens. (2) Tap Try split below: the app opens the map, then sends the Android split-screen command. If the firmware supports it, the map takes one half and the launcher shows in the other. Then reopen Diagnostics and check the line for multi-window mode.
Only used to send the Android split-screen command. It does not read the screen or track what you do.
